headline: Kelly Clarkson Brooklyn shop security footage released
post:
Security cameras caught Kelly Clarkson during her recent visit to a Brooklyn shop, according to Page Six. Journalist Pablo Torre shared the silent footage on his podcast, showing the singer browsing for under five minutes before her viral dispute over a rare mechanical bird named Molly. 

The video shows the star interacting briefly with a staff member and later gesturing animatedly near the doorway before leaving. The feud began when the singer publicly accused an employee of treating her poorly over the $15,000 item. Meanwhile, the store countered that the item was never for sale and criticized the public complaints as an alleged "reprehensible abuse of power". 

Sources close to the singer shared that her reaction was unusual for her personality. Do you think security footage helps clear up celebrity disputes? 🐦

#KellyClarkson #PageSix #Brooklyn
original_title: Security footage shows Kelly Clarkson interaction at Brooklyn store where viral dispute over mechanical singing bird occurred
